courses.title: Superconducting Qubits 101
courses.blurb: Build a transmon from an LC circuit and a Josephson junction, then couple it to a resonator: circuit quantization, cQED, readout and calibration.

start.text: Start with “Your First Superconducting Qubit, Part I”, then Part II. You need undergraduate quantum mechanics and LC circuits.

courses.title: Introduction to Quantum Noise
courses.blurb: What noise does to a real quantum computer: coherent and incoherent errors, finite sampling, state-preparation and measurement errors, and how they compound with circuit depth.

start.text: Start with the 2023 main lecture; the 2021 and 2022 editions cover the same ground. You need qubits, gates and density matrices.

courses.title: Quantum Error Mitigation
courses.blurb: Getting accurate answers from noisy processors: probabilistic error cancellation, zero-noise extrapolation, twirling, and the cost of each, first taught at the 2023 Boulder School for Condensed Matter and Materials Physics, with applications to non-equilibrium quantum dynamics.

start.text: Start with the 2024 Lecture 1, then the 2023 Boulder lectures in order.

materials.label: Boulder School for Condensed Matter and Materials Physics

courses.title: A Primer on Pauli Twirling
courses.blurb: Twirling averages a gate's noise into Pauli noise, a form that can be learned and canceled. A four-part tutorial, from the definition to its use in error mitigation.

courses.title: Quantum Hardware Design with Quantum Metal and EPR
courses.blurb: Design, simulate and quantize a superconducting chip with open-source tools: layout in Quantum Metal, electromagnetic analysis, and the energy-participation ratio.

materials.label: YouTube tutorial series (29+ videos) (Quantum Metal tutorials and videos)

courses.title: Quantum Measurement
courses.blurb: What a measurement does to a quantum system, from projective measurement to continuous monitoring and quantum jumps.
